headline: ILLIT win at Japan Record Awards for 3rd straight year
sub: First K-pop group to do it; CORTIS and &TEAM also honored
source: Source: Yonhap News, Japan Record Awards
caption:
ILLIT have been named winners at Japan's Japan Record Awards for the third year in a row.

The group received an Excellent Work Award at the 68th Japan Record Awards, one of 10 songs chosen for the honor this year. Korean media report ILLIT are the first K-pop group to win at the awards three years running. CORTIS picked up the Special International Music Award, and &TEAM received a Special Award.

📌 Source: Yonhap News (via Korean media), Japan Record Awards
